title: Labor Unemployment Risk and CEO Incentive Compensation
authors: Andrew Ellul; Cong Wang; Kuo Zhang
eligible_reason: The main identification (Tables 3-7, 9) uses a continuous state-year treatment, lnmaxbenefit = log(max weekly UI benefit x max duration), in firm and year FE regressions with time-varying firm and state controls ($ctv); Table 9 is IV (ivreghdfe). Table 8 is a separate event-window DiD on DiDSample.dta: reghdfe flowvega treat post treat_post [$ctv], a(firmid year), and the event-study version includes event-time main effects D_2..D2 for all firms plus treat. The event-time main effects D_k and post (defined relative to each event year, not calendar time) are nonredundant additive regressors (PROTOCOL 5b: event-time main effects for all units make a column ineligible), and the treat/control event-window construction around each UI change is a cohort-matched stacked-type design. Column 2 of Panel B also adds time-varying controls. No data files are shipped.
design_notes: Firm-year Execucomp panel 1992-2016. Tables 3-7: reghdfe flowvega lnmaxbenefit $ctv, a(firmid year) (and ff48#year, stateid, exeid variants), cluster stateid; $ctv = size lev mb roa tang lnstkvol tenure age chairman cashcomp flowdelta gdpgr unemp (all time-varying). Table 4: subsample splits. Table 7: falsification with leads/border-state benefits. Table 9: IV of firm risk-taking on flowvega instrumented by lnmaxbenefit. Table 8 (DiDSample.dta, 4,643 obs): treatment firms are headquartered in states with a large UI benefit change and control firms are matched peers; window t=-2..+2 around the event year; Panel A: treat x D_k plus D_k plus treat with firm and year FE; Panel B: treat post treat_post with and without $ctv, cluster firmid. The variable dictionary defines treat = 1 for treatment firms, post = 1 for periods after the event year, D_k = indicator for event year k over the DiD window.
estimators_reported: event-window treat/control DiD with event-time main effects (Table 8)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not determinable without DiDSample.dta; Table 8 is built around state UI benefit change events.
